turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Bridget said I have gained one kilo and I want to scream.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. It is not easy to talk about.
Take your time.
Aisha and I cooked dinner together and I ate it without counting.
How did that feel for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. It is not easy to talk about.
Mm-hm. Go on.
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
My father emailed about summer internships at his chambers, like nothing is happening.
What happened next?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. That is how it was.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I went to the peer support group on Wednesday and everyone there understood me.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. Yes, it was like that.
What happened next?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Let us stop here for today.
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
